items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: But there was a guy there who was also in the police band named Filiberto Sanchez that they all respected

ctx.x: Oh, yes ... I remember his name, but I can't recall it now.

But there was a guy there who was also in the police band named Filiberto Sanchez that they all respected; I mean, all of the bongo players and congo players respected him, but he couldn't leave because he was on the police force and he had a big family. But he was very much respected by all the fellows around there, and that's where I met Migelito Valdez' brother -- Daddio? Remember Daddio? Pozo's
And Chino's brother who played the violin?
